programs.input_format: Line 1: total_staked. Line 2: daily_reward. Line 3: token_price. Line 4: staked_token_price
programs.source: m=apy;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=main():$i64{let total=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let daily=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let price=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let stakeprice=s.tofloat(s.trim(io.readln()));let dailyvalue=daily*price;let dailyyield=dailyvalue/total;let apy=dailyyield*365.0*100.0;io.println(s.format(apy;"%.2f"));<0}
